relationship_description: Cherrylyn Akbar is the widow of Wahab Akbar, former Basilan governor and congressman
Cherrylyn Akbar is the sister-in-law of Jum J. Akbar, who is also a member of the Akbar political family in Basilan
Cheryl Deloso-Montalla is the sister of Rosemarie Deloso, both members of the Deloso political family in Zambales
Cheryl Deloso-Montalla is the niece of Vicente Magsaysay, former Zambales governor, linking the Deloso and Magsaysay dynasties
Cheryl Catamco is married to Ruben Catamco, both involved in North Cotabato politics
Cheryl Catamco and Lala Talino-Mendoza are political allies in North Cotabato, both from prominent local dynasties
Chery Deloso-Montalla and Cheryl Deloso-Montalla refer to the same individual, a member of the Deloso dynasty in Zambales
